item.title: Walk anyway, 12 s

turns.text:
Make a 12-second 16:9 video from this description. There are no reference images.

Character: a tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots. Keep her looking the same in every shot.

Three beats, in this order:
1. She waits at a bus stop in the rain.
2. The bus passes without stopping.
3. She laughs and walks away.

End on her back as she walks away, with the words "walk anyway" on screen. Give me one finished video file.

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#abb6bb"/>

            stroke="#e2edf2" stroke-width="2" opacity=".48"/>

    <g id="woman">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="9" rx="47" ry="9"
               fill="#172d3a" opacity=".25"/>

        <path d="M-27-64h21v53h-34v-13l12-5z">

        </path>
        <path d="M8-64h21v53H-3v-13l11-5z">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"

        </path>
      </g>

      <g>
        <!-- Brief shoulder bounce suggests laughter. -->
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
          begin="8s" dur=".25s" repeatCount="4"
          values="0 0;0 -5;0 0"/>
        <path d="M-24-225Q0-239 24-225L40-75

              fill="#d83938" stroke="#a72e32" stroke-width="3"/>
        <path d="M-24-219L-45-139M24-219L44-143"

        <path d="M0-204V-80" stroke="#b62c30" stroke-width="2"/>

                stroke="#875748" stroke-width="2">
            <animate attributeName="d" begin="8s" dur=".3s"
              values="M7-251q7 3 12-2;M5-253q8 13 16-1"

    <path d="M40 565q100-30 230 0m320 0q100-30 210 0"
          fill="none" stroke="#d5e3e9" stroke-width="8" opacity=".3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rain moves for twelve seconds, then holds. -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate"
      values="0 -90;0 0" dur="1s" repeatCount="12" fill="freeze"/>
    <rect y="-90" width="1280" height="900" fill="url(#rain)"/>

  <text x="640" y="650" text-anchor="middle"
